$comment: Which files and folders use each icon. Edited by hand; rules in spec.md section 8. Keys are lowercase, appear once in the whole file, and may carry one parent folder ("parent/name"). node build.mjs refuses anything else.

files.description: C# source and scripts (Cake build scripts are C#).
Generated C# (WinForms/Resx designers, source generators, AssemblyInfo).
ASP.NET views/pages: Razor, Blazor components, WebForms.
Kotlin source/scripts (build.gradle.kts itself goes to gradle via fileNames).
JS/JSX unit, spec and e2e tests.
TS/TSX unit, spec, type and e2e tests.

Python test plumbing written in Python: pytest fixtures (conftest.py). INI runner configs (pytest.ini, tox.ini) and noxfile.py (v5) are config, so they go to test-config. test_*.py itself is NOT expressible.
Go source (x_test.go is NOT expressible; same icon).
HTML and server templates rendered as HTML (JSP, EJS).
PowerShell scripts and script modules. Data/manifest/session/role/type files -> powershell-config (v5).
PowerShell data/manifest files (.psd1), session configurations, role capabilities, type/format XML.
GraphQL config, GraphQL Code Generator and Apollo config.
Protocol Buffers/Thrift IDL + generated stubs. Buf config -> proto-config, buf.lock -> proto-lock (v5).
Fallback for programming languages outside the core stack (only via languageIds, so any extension that registers them lights up).
Solution files (incl. new XML .slnx and filters).
ASP.NET/.NET runtime settings + launch profiles + web.config transforms.
NuGet packages, specs and Paket/packages.config manifests. nuget.config -> nuget-config, lockfiles -> nuget-lock (v5).
Maven POM, wrapper scripts and core-extensions list. Wrapper properties and .mvn/*.config -> maven-config (v5).
Maven wrapper properties and .mvn/ JVM/Maven options.
Gradle build scripts, wrapper, version catalog, properties. gradle.lockfile -> gradle-lock (v5).
Spring Boot / Java app configuration and logging config.
TypeScript project config (tsconfig.*.json has no glob -> common names listed).
JS tooling config: jsconfig, Babel, SWC, nodemon, browserslist, commitlint, lint-staged, framework configs.
webpack, Rollup, Rspack, esbuild, tsup, Parcel configs.
Next.js config and env typings (fileNames beat the d.ts extension).
Test runner / coverage configuration (Jest, Vitest, Playwright, Cypress, Karma, Mocha, nyc, Codecov, pytest, tox).
Python project manifests (pyproject, setup, Pipfile, conda env, pixi). hatch.toml -> python-config (v5).
pip requirement/constraint lists (requirements*.txt has no glob -> common names listed).
Python lockfiles (Pipenv, Poetry, uv, PDM, Rye, pixi, conda-lock).
Python tooling config (version pin, linters, type checkers, coverage).
Generic key/value config (ini, cfg, conf, properties).
dotenv files. languageId 'dotenv' (built-in, pattern .env.*) catches every .env.<anything>.
VS Code workspace/extension files. .vscode/<file> uses the parent-folder syntax.
Colour/icon/grammar theme files. NOTE: 'x-color-theme.json' (hyphen) is NOT an extension match; it is caught by the 'themes/json' parent-folder rule.
Generic ignore files (built-in languageId 'ignore' + tool ignores without their own concept).
JSON family. jsonc/jsonl languages fall back here.
YAML. MAPPED BY languageIds ONLY (not fileExtensions yml/yaml) so built-in 'dockercompose' and extension languages (github-actions-workflow, azure-pipelines, helm) can win.
XML and XML-based UI/markup (XAML, plist, schemas).
Markdown/MDX/reST. Markdown mapped by languageIds (NOT fileExtensions md) so AI prompt languages (chatagent/instructions/prompt/skill) win.
SVG (xml language; the extension mapping wins).
Executables, libraries, debug symbols, packages, wasm.
AI-agent instructions, prompts, skills and MCP config (built-in chatagent/instructions/prompt/skill languages).
Dockerfile/Containerfile (+ built-in 'dockerfile' language catches Dockerfile.*), dev containers.
Compose files: built-in 'dockercompose' language (compose.*.yml, *docker*compose*.yml) + explicit names.
Git metadata, hooks config and commit/rebase buffers.
GitHub Actions workflows (parent-folder rule 'workflows/yml') and action metadata.
Other CI/CD + PaaS deploy configs (GitLab, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, CircleCI, Bitbucket, Vercel, Netlify, Fly...).
Helm charts, Kustomize, Skaffold (arbitrary k8s manifests have no fixed names -> folder icon).
Terraform/OpenTofu/HCL source and state. Variable files and tool config -> terraform-config, .terraform.lock.hcl -> terraform-lock (v5).
Terraform variable files, CLI/TFLint/Terragrunt config, version pin.
Terraform/OpenTofu dependency lockfile (.terraform.lock.hcl; it used to match the hcl extension).
Rust toolchain/format/lint config (rustup, rustfmt, clippy, cargo-deny, .cargo/config, rust-analyzer).
C/C++ headers with the ambiguous .h extension.
C++/CUDA headers, inline and template implementation files.
C/C++ tooling and package config: clang-format/tidy, clangd, compilation databases, vcpkg, Conan. conan.lock -> c-lock (v5).
CMake lists and modules. Presets and CMakeCache.txt -> cmake-config (v5).
CMake presets and the generated CMakeCache.txt.
PHP tooling config: PHPStan, Psalm, PHP-CS-Fixer, Pint, PHP_CodeSniffer, Rector, ECS, php.ini (PHPUnit goes to test-config).
Laravel's artisan console script (a PHP CLI entry point, not a Blade template).
Ruby source + Ruby task/DSL files (built-in 'ruby' language also catches Vagrantfile, Brewfile, Fastfile, *.erb ...). Guard/Capistrano/Danger/IRB/Pry config -> ruby-config (v5).
Bundler manifest, gemspecs and packaged gems.
Ruby version pins and tooling config (RuboCop, RSpec, Standard, Solargraph, Bundler).
SwiftPM manifest (Package.swift). Package.resolved -> swift-lock, SwiftLint/SwiftFormat/.swift-version -> swift-config (v5).
Objective-C/C++ (.m is only matched through the language id, so MATLAB .m keeps MATLAB when its extension is installed).
build_runner output: json_serializable, freezed, auto_route, mockito, chopper.
Dart/Flutter tooling config: analyzer options, l10n, FVM, launcher icons, splash, devtools, .metadata.
Lua/Luau source. Rockspecs -> lua-package, Lua tooling config -> lua-config (v5).
Lua tooling config: LuaLS, luacheck, StyLua, selene.
R source and R Markdown. Project/session config -> r-config, renv.lock -> r-lock, workspace data -> r-data (v5).
R/RStudio project and session config: .Rproj, .Rprofile, .Renviron, lintr.
Scala source and sbt build definitions. sbt/scalafmt/scalafix config -> scala-config (v5).
Elixir source, EEx/HEEx templates, Livebook, Mix (mix.exs matches by extension). mix.lock -> elixir-lock (v5).
Haskell source. .cabal -> haskell-package, Stack/Cabal locks -> haskell-lock, project/tooling config -> haskell-config (v5).
Stack lockfile and Cabal freeze file.
Stack/Cabal project config and Haskell tooling config (hie, GHCi, HLint, Fourmolu).
Visual Basic .NET, VBScript, VBA modules (+ BrightScript via the built-in 'vb' language).
Perl and Raku source. cpanfile -> perl-package, perltidy/perlcritic -> perl-config (v5).
Groovy source (built-in 'groovy' language also catches Jenkinsfile.* and Nextflow .nf).
MATLAB/Octave (.m via the language id only: the built-in maps .m to Objective-C), live scripts, apps, Simulink.
Nix expressions and flakes. flake.lock/devbox.lock -> nix-lock, devbox.json -> nix-config (v5).
GPU shaders: GLSL, HLSL, WGSL, Metal, Unity ShaderLab/CG, Unreal USF.
Vue single-file components (+ the shims-vue.d.ts declaration). vue.config.* -> vue-config (v5).
Svelte components and Svelte 5 rune modules (.svelte.ts/.js). svelte.config.* -> svelte-config (v5).
Angular components (*.component.ts; the .spec.ts sibling stays typescript-test, .html/.scss keep their language).
*.service.ts (Angular, NestJS and other TS backends: deliberately NOT branded).
Request-pipeline hooks: guards, interceptors, resolvers, middleware (Angular router + NestJS).
Tailwind CSS config (v3 JS config; v4 is CSS-first).
Yarn lockfile and the generated Plug'n'Play loaders (install state). .yarnrc* -> yarn-config (v5).
pnpm workspace file and pnpmfile hooks.
Deno config and JSR package manifest. deno.lock -> deno-lock (v5).
Firebase project config, security rules/indexes, Google services files.
Supabase CLI project config and seed.
Netlify config and redirect/header rule files (also used by Cloudflare Pages).
Cloudflare Workers/Pages (Wrangler) config and local vars.
React Native / Expo tooling config (Metro, RN CLI, EAS, expo-env).
Django manage.py and Django templates (language ids from the Django extension).
Jinja2/Nunjucks templates (.j2 also catches nginx.conf.j2 etc.).
Crawler/site-policy files: robots, humans, ads, security.txt, sitemaps.
Site identity: favicons, touch icons, web app manifest, browserconfig.
Claude Code memory/settings and Claude Desktop config.
Gemini CLI / Code Assist context, settings and ignore files.
GitHub Copilot repository instructions and coding-agent setup steps.
Model Context Protocol server config (.mcp.json, mcp.json incl. .vscode/.cursor).
Azure Pipelines (Microsoft marks are not in simple-icons: draw a generic mark in the logo edition too).
Jenkins pipelines (Jenkinsfile.* falls back to the groovy concept through the built-in language).
Helm charts: Chart.yaml, helpers and Helm templates (language id). Values/helmfile -> helm-config, Chart.lock -> helm-lock, .helmignore -> ignore (v5).
Helm values files (incl. common per-env values and the values schema) and helmfile.
Ansible config/lint/galaxy files + the Ansible extension's 'ansible' language (playbooks).
Polyglot version-manager pins (asdf, mise, proto, SDKMAN, jenv, goenv, bun).
Spell/prose checkers: CSpell, typos, codespell, Vale.
Gherkin BDD feature files (Cucumber, SpecFlow/Reqnroll, Behave).
Diagram sources: draw.io, Excalidraw, tldraw, PlantUML, Mermaid, D2, Graphviz.
Design-tool documents: Figma, Sketch, XD, Illustrator, EPS, Affinity, InDesign, GIMP, Krita, CorelDRAW, Penpot.
3D models/scenes and CAD: glTF, FBX, OBJ-free set (see note), STL, Blender, USD, Maya, 3ds Max, STEP/IGES.
ML weights/tensors and serialized Python data: ONNX, PyTorch, safetensors, GGUF, TFLite, Core ML, Keras/HDF5, joblib/pickle, NumPy.
LaTeX/TeX sources, styles and BibTeX (.cls only through the built-in tex language id, so Salesforce Apex .cls keeps its own language).
Docs/static-site generator config: VitePress, Eleventy, Jekyll, Hugo, mdBook, Antora, Sphinx (docs/conf.py), Doxygen, TypeDoc, Read the Docs, Mintlify.
Android manifest, R8/ProGuard rules, AIDL, SDK path file.
Xcode projects/schemes/build settings, Interface Builder, entitlements, Info.plist.
CocoaPods Podfile and podspecs. Podfile.lock -> cocoapods-lock (v5).
Unity scenes, prefabs, assets, .meta, animation, asmdefs, input actions, shader graphs, packages.
Godot: GDScript and Godot shaders. Scenes/resources -> godot-scene, project/export/.import/.uid -> godot-config (v5).
Godot project/export settings and generated .import/.uid sidecars, GDExtension descriptors.
Qt: QML, qmake projects, resources, Designer .ui, stylesheets.

Bazel (Starlark) build files (*.bazel, *.bzl, WORKSPACE). A bare 'BUILD' file is NOT mapped: too many shell scripts are called 'build'. rc/version/ignore -> bazel-config, MODULE.bazel.lock -> bazel-lock (v5).
Bazel/Bazelisk rc, version pin and ignore list.
Azure Bicep templates and params. bicepconfig.json -> bicep-config (v5).
AWS CDK/SAM/Amplify/CodeDeploy and Serverless Framework config.
Azure Developer CLI, Static Web Apps and ARM deployment templates.
OpenAPI/Swagger specs (named or *.openapi.*) and API linters (Spectral, Redocly).
Translation catalogs: gettext, Flutter ARB, Apple strings/stringsdict/String Catalogs.
Husky git hooks (.husky/<hook>) and legacy rc files.
